title: The Margin: The Stolen Weave
subtitle: Book 1
author: The Margin Table
description: When the Three Fates edit human history, displaced souls slip through the seams of reality. Stranded in the timeless refuge of the Margin, an eccentric team—a French youth with Gorgon blood, a Stanford Greek history professor, a Vegas gambler fathered by the God of Death, and a sentient driftwood doll—must travel the Lost Roads to recover the reality-warping Fragments of time.

author_note.title: A NOTE FROM THE AUTHORS
paragraphs: Stories begin in strange, unexpected ways. This one began around a tabletop, where friends and Game Master Luke Foreman set out to explore what happens when the fabric of destiny frays at the edges.

What you hold here is the chronicle of Pierre, Professor Dravin, Eusacles, and Alfie—novelized directly from our living campaign transcripts, preserving every line of dialogue, every chaotic gamble, and every heartbeat of their journey.
To the players, the storytellers, and everyone who ever looked beyond the edge of the world: thank you.
